scope: Fresh local Kind Kubernetes v1.36.1 only. Uses synthetic case-owned ServiceAccounts, one synthetic namespace, a namespaced approval-registry CRD, narrowly scoped RBAC, and two ValidatingAdmissionPolicy bindings. Demonstrates baseline acceptance of unapproved metadata, RBAC denial for an ordinary workload identity, typed admission denial for an RBAC-authorized registrar with stored-value preservation, and approved metadata registration/readback. RequestResponse audit covers updates to the named synthetic ServiceAccount and namespace. Secret and token resources are excluded. Does not establish production policy coverage, cloud federation behavior, token audiences, or audit retention outside this disposable cluster.

checks.claim: Registrar RBAC permits the baseline unapproved ServiceAccount annotation before admission
Registrar RBAC permits the baseline unapproved namespace label before admission
Ordinary workload identity cannot update the case ServiceAccount
Ordinary workload identity cannot update the case namespace
Admission rejects registrar's unapproved annotation and preserves the original value
Admission rejects registrar's unapproved namespace label and preserves the original value
Registrar can register and read back the exact approved ServiceAccount annotation
Registrar can register and read back the exact approved namespace label
Registrar cannot remove either protected registered attribute
An ordinary namespace metadata update leaves named-object enforcement in place
API audit retains approved and denied outcomes for both protected attributes
